selection.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation MAE within each preselected run; no test ranking
selection.release_scope: historical daylight-compressed protocol; opt-in experimental inference; not energy-v3 unified main result
selection.tolerance_note: CPU/GPU float32 inference is numerically close but not bitwise identical for long horizons. All reported max deltas are retained; acceptance is norm atol=1e-3/rtol=1e-4 and absolute error <=0.1% nominal Cap. This tolerance validates deployment numerical equivalence, not metric reproduction or training correctness.

scaler_reconstruction: exact delivered train-prefix min/max, float32 pandas arithmetic; original multi-step boundary overlap disclosed
capacity_basis: filename nominal MW * 1000, available AC/DC status unverified
history_sampling: 06:00..18:45 every 15min; next retained point is next-day06:00
online_output_policy: only same-day daylight target timestamps; reject cross-night target path; not an overnight or day-ahead forecast

upstream.paper: Liu et al. 2026, Adaptive multi-scale perception-based decoupled network for efficient and accurate photovoltaic forecasting, Solar Energy 312, 114563
upstream.license: not verified; pinned checkout has no LICENSE; no new redistribution license granted

limitations: multi-step target boundary overlaps in original training
Solar2 100MW filtering and Solar8 interpolated labels retained in training; not repaired by inference
20 epochs completed does not establish convergence
